question: Is egress/locyanfrp dead, or only unreachable at one hostname? www.locyanfrp.cn is a CNAME to a CDN name that is NXDOMAIN, the apex locyanfrp.cn resolves but does not accept TCP on 443, and the Wayback copy of the apex dated 2026-05-15 is a CDN not-found page. A read of the first-party page was not possible on 2026-11-03.
why: Every route to the page failed (broker read HTTP 530, broker pins refused, fetch and archive routes, DNS and TCP probes), so the rung cannot be raised; the record's verdict dead rests on an unreachable site, not on a statement of closure. Re-read the page after the DNS is repaired, or find the vendor's announcement of a new domain (the vendor's company site locyan.cn still links to www.locyanfrp.cn).
